activities.title: First Meeting of Timeback in Millbrae
activities.description: Aliya, Millbrae's regional chapter director, held the first Timeback chapter meeting. She went over Timeback's mission, future activities, and possible roles of Millbrae's chapter.

photos.caption: Aliya presents TimeBack at the Millbrae chapter meeting.
The TimeBack Millbrae chapter meets for the first time.
